           THYMUS SERPYLLUM

         Wild Thyme


Respiratory infections of children; dry nervous asthma, whooping-cough,
        severe spasms but little sputum.


Ringing in ears with feeling of pressure in head. Burning in pharynx,
        sore, throat worse empty swallowing; blood vessels distended, dark.
